controles.verbatim_source: Item 1. Legal Proceedings. There are no material pending legal proceedings to which we are a party or of which any of our property is the subject. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance optionnelle : la note 'Litigation' des comptes dit 'Management is not aware of any legal, environmental or other commitments or contingencies that would have a material effect... other than as described below' et decrit ensuite un contentieux de taxes ad valorem sur les interets de redevance historiques (un tiers a cesse de les payer, TPL provisionne). Ce n'est pas une procedure judiciaire, mais l'affirmation 'aucun litige materiel' peut etre completee par cette contingence fiscale.

controles.affirmation: Vente de terrain a Chevron pour 42,5 M$, avec un simple paiement nominal en cash a la signature et le solde en versements annuels jusqu'en 2046
controles.verbatim_source: As part of the agreement, we sold land for aggregate consideration of $42.5 million... The consideration consisted of a nominal cash payment received at closing and annual payments due to us through 2046. (10-Q T2 2026, note 4 Land Sales)

controles.affirmation: 20,9 M$ de revenus de vente de terrains comptabilises au S1 2026 ; creance de financement actualisee a 7,5%
controles.verbatim_source: We recognized land sales revenue of $20.9 million at closing and recorded a financing receivable for the deferred consideration. The financing receivable was recorded at its present value of $20.9 million, which represents the contractual payments of $42.4 million discounted at an effective interest rate of 7.5%. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Precision : le taux de 7,5% s'applique aux 42,4 M$ de PAIEMENTS CONTRACTUELS futurs, montant distinct des 42,5 M$ de contrepartie totale de la vente. L'ATT ecrit 'le solde des 42,5 M$ de contrepartie totale... actualise a 7,5%', ce qui melange les deux montants. Le 10-Q emploie bien les deux chiffres (42,5 puis 42,4).

controles.affirmation: Chevron detient une option de vente qui pourrait forcer TPL a racheter le terrain si certains jalons de developpement ne sont pas atteints
controles.verbatim_source: This agreement also provides for a put option held by the developer and a call option held by us regarding our repurchase of the land if certain development milestones are not achieved. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le 10-Q ecrit 'the developer', pas nommement Chevron. Le paragraphe identifie bien Chevron comme le developpeur du Project Kilby, la lecture est donc raisonnable, mais ecrire 'le developpeur (Chevron)' serait plus fidele.

controles.affirmation: Modele 100% passif : les revenus dependent des decisions de developpement d'operateurs tiers dans le bassin permien ; 77,5% de marge operationnelle au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: our segment revenues are directly influenced by development decisions made by our customers, the overall activity level in the Permian Basin and commodity prices (10-Q T2 2026). Operating income 374,145 / Total revenues 482,877 sur 6 mois = 77,5%.

controles.affirmation: Segment eau : 33,4% du CA consolide au T2 2026 (82,2 M$ sur 246,1 M$), en hausse de 39,2% sur un an
Environ 894 000 acres de surface et environ 224 000 acres nettes de redevance, principalement concentrees dans le bassin permien
controles.verbatim_source: one of the largest land and royalty owners in the State of Texas with approximately 894,000 surface acres of land, principally concentrated in the Permian Basin ; The Company owns approximately 224,000 NRA as of June 30, 2026 (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Revenus de servitudes du segment Terres et Ressources a 18,3 M$ au T2 2026 contre 33,5 M$ un an plus tot (-45,4%), du a un recul de 15,0 M$ des servitudes de pipeline ; poste imprevisible par nature
controles.verbatim_source: Easements and other surface-related income was $18.3 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026, compared to $33.5 million... The decrease... was principally related to a decrease of $15.0 million in pipeline easements... Easements and other surface-related income is dependent on development decisions made by companies that operate in the areas where we own land and is, therefore, unpredictable and may vary significantly from period to period. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.verbatim_source: Natural gas (MMcf) 7,161 / 5,659 ; Natural gas royalties 2,618 / 4,574 ; Realized prices Natural gas ($/Mcf) $0.40 / $0.87 (10-Q T2 2026, tableau des redevances). 2,618/246,059 = 1,06%.

controles.verbatim_source: Oil (MBbls) 1,280 / 1,209 ; Oil royalties $119,273 / $73,893 ; Realized prices Oil ($/Bbl) $97.55 / $63.99 (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: TPL attribue la hausse du prix du petrole a un conflit militaire en Iran ayant perturbe le detroit d'Ormuz, avec des prix au-dessus de 90 $ le baril de mars a debut juin, et un impact incertain pour la suite de 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In February 2026, an escalating military conflict in Iran led to attacks on energy infrastructure in the broader Middle East and caused major disruptions to the Strait of Hormuz... global oil prices this year increased to over $90 per barrel from March through early-June with continued volatility in July. The impact to oil prices for the balance of 2026 and beyond are uncertain and, in part, dependent on the duration of the conflict in Iran... (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Tresorerie utilisee en investissement 139,4 M$ au S1 2026 contre 16,5 M$ un an plus tot, dont 110,2 M$ d'acquisitions
controles.verbatim_source: For the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, cash used in investing activities was $139.4 million and $16.5 million, respectively. For the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, cash used for acquisitions totaled $110.2 million and $8.1 million, respectively. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Aucun montant tire sur le credit renouvelable de 500 M$ ; CA +31,2% et resultat net +32,5% a 153,9 M$ au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: ...revolving credit agreement... providing for total commitments of $500.0 million... The facility remains undrawn as of June 30, 2026. ; Total revenues 246,059 vs 187,543 (+31,2%) ; Net income $153,930 vs $116,140 (+32,5%) (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : 'sans un dollar tire' est exact, mais la facilite genere quand meme un cout : 'For the three months ended June 30, 2026, interest expense related to the Credit Facility was $1.0 million, including $0.3 million of amortization of debt issuance costs'. La formule 'structure de capital jusque-la sans dette' (ce_qui_affaiblirait) merite donc d'etre nuancee.
